'''Rait''' was a [[Chadra-Fan/Legends|Chadra-Fan]] who worked for the criminal [[Big Bunji/Legends|Big Bunji]] as a spy and lookout. He was nervous when with people he did not know, but could be quite precocious with friends. He understood but could not speak Basic. He carried a [[Stun pistol]] and knick-knacks on his person.<ref name="There's Many a Slip Betwixt Cup and Lip" />
